title: button variant roles
name: Button variant roles — MUI
rule: Text = less-pronounced (typical in dialogs and cards; on cards, text buttons keep emphasis on card content). Contained = high-emphasis (elevation + fill); primary to the app. Outlined = medium-emphasis: important but not the primary; lower than contained, higher than text.
pass_when: Variant matches that role map (text / outlined / contained).
fail_when: Contained used for a low-emphasis card action, or text used as the app's primary.
overview: Text, outlined, and contained button variants map to low, medium, and high emphasis.
apply_when: Choosing MUI button variants for dialogs, cards, and app primary actions.
not_when: Not for links styled as text without button semantics, or icon-only affordances.
agent_hint: Map text/outlined/contained to emphasis; keep contained for the app primary.
description: Text buttons are less pronounced—typical in dialogs and cards so card content stays primary. Contained is high emphasis with elevation and fill for the app primary. Outlined is medium: important but not primary, sitting between contained and text. Match variant to that role map so emphasis stays honest. Fail if contained is used for a low-emphasis card action, or text is used as the app’s primary. Apply when choosing MUI button variants for dialogs, cards, and primary actions.
do_not_claim: One-primary page cap as this variant-map row; M3 max-two-actions (not on this MUI page).
